description: Global linear deconvolution via Wiener filter learned from training neurons. We robustly standardize each train trace (median/MAD), compute aggregated auto-correlation of calcium and cross-correlation with spikes using FFT-based convolution, then solve a ridge-regularized Toeplitz normal equation to obtain a single two-sided FIR filter (acausal and causal lags ±0.8 s at 100 Hz). For test neurons, we robustly standardize each trace, apply the learned two-sided filter via efficient lagged additions, and rectify to enforce nonnegativity. Trailing NaNs in inputs remain NaN in outputs; predictions are finite where inputs are finite. No mixing across neuron boundaries or use of test labels. The method is simple, fast, and scale/offset agnostic (correlation metric is scale-invariant).
